title: Markov Chain Monte Carlo Methods, a survey with some frequent misunderstandings
comment: To appear in the Handbook of Computational Statistics, John Wiley & Sons
abstract: In this chapter, we review some of the most standard MCMC tools used in Bayesian computation, along with vignettes on standard misunderstandings of these approaches taken from Q \&~A's on the forum Cross-validated answered by the first author.
